title.narrative: Power in Partnership: A strategy to end AIDS

description.narrative:
Our new strategy sets out how we will focus on three strategic priorities to achieve our goal to build a future free from AIDS and respond to challenges through the power of our global partnership. We will:
1) Strengthen health systems by working collaboratively to secure sustainably financed, resilient and inclusive HIV and health services 2) Champion human rights and gender and racial justice to counter anti-rights mobilisation and shift hostile narratives and 3) Build resilience to crises by brokering partnerships and sharing and scaling up community-led approaches that keep delivering in times of need.
